description: This Java source file defines the Cache class, which manages entity caching mechanisms including entity cache, list cache, and object cache within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Manages caching of entity data, including individual entities, lists, and objects, with methods for adding, retrieving, and removing cache entries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries by entity name, condition, or primary key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached entities or values based on primary key or condition.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds entities or values to cache, with hooks for auto-clear cache settings.
